run: qs ipc call plugins status | jq -r '[.plugins[] | select(.id == "example-clock" and .state == "loaded")] | length'
horneroctl plugin disable example-clock --yes >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo disabled || echo refused
qs ipc call plugins reload >/dev/null 2>&1; qs ipc call plugins status | jq -r '[.plugins[] | select(.id == "example-clock")] | .[0].state'
qs ipc call plugins status | jq -r .failed
horneroctl plugin enable example-clock --yes >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo enabled || echo refused
qs ipc call plugins reload >/dev/null 2>&1; qs ipc call plugins status | jq -r '[.plugins[] | select(.id == "example-clock" and .state == "loaded")] | length'
